segments.text: IT was ſaid, that the mediatour is a perſon reconciling parties which are at variance. Nowe this reconciliation in the ſcriptures is termed the Couenaunt, and Teſtament, which is the correlatiue, that is, hath a mutuall reſpect to the mediatour. Wherefore the Doctrine which treateth of the Couenaunt is linked with the place concerning the mediatour, becauſe euerie mediatour is the mediatour of ſome Couenaunt, and a reconciler of parties who are at enmitie.

The chiefe queſtions are,
1 What a Couenaunt is.
2 Whether it can be made without a mediatour.
3 Whether there be but one and the ſame Couenaunt, or more.
4 In what the old and new Couenaunt agree, and in what they differ.
